item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #SLPRSD
Issued at 05:10 PM 26 October 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Romblon(Romblon, SantaMaria, Odiongan, Looc, Alcantara, Ferrol, SantaFe, SanJose, Calatrava, SanAndres, SanAgustin), #Catanduanes(Caramoran, SanMiguel, Bato), #CamarinesSur(Caramoan, Presentacion, Garchitorena, Lagonoy and SanJose) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Romblon(Cajidiocan, SanFernando, Magdiwang), #Catanduanes(SanAndres and Virac) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
